# Which readings persist

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`which-readings-persist` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F07 · [record](which-readings-persist.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> A line's standing late tells readings apart only by what their acts do within its coupling closure. In a witness where nothing comes back a line clearing a dweller's habitat persists as a sparing one does, an overdrawing one ends; where the dweller renews the source, the clearing line ends with it.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. Let a line carry one of two readings: the rest acts by a law of what has stood reading through coupling; the two acts are laws of what has stood, the first reading each slot's couplings only, agreeing under every history on what couples into the line's coupling closure drawn through both courses; both feasible; own standing coupled in. The slots stand late in the one course exactly when in the other. (`Becoming.StandsLate`, `Becoming.Web.standsLate_readOffCouplings`, `Becoming.Flow.lineOf_standsLate`, `Becoming.line_standing_unselected`, `Becoming.line_standing_unselected_of_reads`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* closure and balance; its declarations reach the grammar.
2. A witness world: a line of two slots passing its standing on and drawing on a source; a dweller's line of two slots requiring a habitat; three readings (the line only, drawing two and clearing; the line and its source, drawing one and clearing; everything, drawing one and sparing). The acts read what has stood and only what couples into their relatum. The lines read off them persist or end as computed. <a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- No axiom. Discrete steps and natural levels; one kind of relatum; a web, the relata present and the starting levels supplied; a coupling by level supplied, holding each slot's own standing.
- The two acts agree, under every level history, on everything coupled into the line's coupling closure drawn through both courses: a premise on the acts, met in the witness, not derived; where they differ there, the difference can be selected, as the witness's overdrawing reading shows.
- The rest acts by a law of what has stood reading through coupling, the first act reads each slot's couplings only, and both courses are feasible; the significance form needs every significance's course feasible.
- The act each reading gives is supplied; in the witness, which conduct each reading gives is designed.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- That a wider reading persists where its loss returns because it is wider: a narrow reading whose act agrees on everything coupled into the line's closure stands late as well, under the law's premises. Witness: `Becoming.line_standing_unselected`.
- Which readings persist among several lines competing for a share: selection here is persistence, all or nothing.
- That persistence implies a line's slots stand late and conversely: only the first direction is proved. Witness: `Becoming.Flow.lineOf_standsLate`.
- That actual lineages, institutions or trained systems act by readings so carried.
- **Counterexample:** Against the reading that persistence selects the wider reading: where nothing comes back from the dweller, the line reading its source clears the habitat and persists as the line reading everything does, and the law holds there with every premise met (Habitat.beyond_which_persist, Habitat.beyond_standing_unselected). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/ReadingsPersist.lean)

**Standard boundaries:** No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used. · Names follow the structural naming criteria and are adopted only where the statement has their exact meaning; readings are interpretations, open to revision. · A law of the formal model; its correspondence to actual systems is a separate obligation. · Stated for discrete steps.

<a id="evidence--证据"></a>
## Evidence

Pure core, axiom report empty; a leaf. The law is act_courses_unselected_throughout with standing late as the selection, near-definitional; the witness has finitely many relata, balance and the lines' fates proved for all steps, every premise of the law discharged. Written by an AI; readers of two other models read it cold (READER); no human audit.

## Next

Several lines carrying different readings under selection by share, read off the course, joined to RuleShaping's counts; and readings that vary along descent, so that which readings arise is on the model with which persist.

<a id="correspondence--对应"></a>
### Correspondence

Reading (the AI's, from its knowledge): a trait whose content leaves the bearer's fitness unchanged has no covariance with it (Price 1970); a cost borne beyond the bearer's coupling is an externality the bearer's own persistence does not register (Pigou 1920); where the cost returns through the bearer's own source, it is the tragedy of the commons read on one line (Hardin 1968).
